title: Jump-Stop Pivot Warm-Up
description: Players jog, catch an imaginary pass, jump-stop and pivot both directions — a simple way to rehearse balance and footwork before contact drills.

content.objective: Rehearse a controlled jump-stop and both front and reverse pivots at an easy pace.
content.setup: Players jog in a loose line across half court with space to stop safely.
instructions: Jog two steps, then jump-stop landing on both feet at once.
Front pivot 180 degrees on the left foot, then reset.
Jump-stop again and reverse pivot 180 degrees on the right foot.
Repeat the sequence while jogging back the other way.
coachingPoints: Land the jump-stop with the feet shoulder-width apart.
Keep the pivot foot planted and spin on the ball of the foot.
Stay low and balanced through the whole pivot.
commonMistakes: Landing the jump-stop on one foot before the other.
Lifting the pivot foot off the floor while turning.
Letting the group's pace drift apart instead of staying together.
content.safety: Give each player a few metres of clear space to land and turn.
